findings.evidence: `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:3733` only pushes `b.inStraightJoin` when `straightJoinFromKeyword||straightJoinFromHint` is true, with no reset path; this contradicts the intended per-SELECT meaning (`pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:238`). Because the parser always creates a non-nil `SelectStmtOpts` even when empty (`pkg/parser/parser.y:10536`), the pre-change code reset `b.inStraightJoin` to false for each SELECT but the new code does not. The inherited flag marks joins as `StraightJoin` (`pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:584`), and join reorder explicitly bails out on `join.StraightJoin` (`pkg/planner/core/rule_join_reorder.go:72`).
findings.fix: In `buildSelect`, always scope `b.inStraightJoin` to the current SELECT by pushing/unconditionally setting it to `straightJoinFromKeyword||straightJoinFromHint` (or that value OR'ed with any intended statement-level flag) and deferring restore, instead of only setting it when the value is true.
findings.impact: Compatibility/semantics: STRAIGHT_JOIN becomes dynamically scoped across nested SELECTs, so subqueries/derived tables/CTEs inside a straight-join query block may unexpectedly preserve SQL join order and skip join reordering. This can change EXPLAIN output and cause large performance regressions for complex nested queries; it also breaks the comment-defined “current SELECT only” scope.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master` (3b531d4e3d99cb988bebccb8f63a96afff0ec6cd): `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go` still uses the same conditional `if straightJoinFromKeyword || straightJoinFromHint { ... }` block, so this behavior remains.
findings.verify: Add an integration test where the outer query uses the `SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN` keyword (not the statement-level `/*+ straight_join() */` hint) and the inner derived-table SELECT has no straight_join; confirm the inner plan still gets reordered (i.e., outer STRAIGHT_JOIN does not affect the derived-table join order). Also verify existing straight_join-in-CTE/subquery tests still pass.
findings.what: `PlanBuilder.inStraightJoin` is no longer reset for SELECT blocks without STRAIGHT_JOIN, so once an outer SELECT enables STRAIGHT_JOIN (keyword or `/*+ straight_join() */`), nested SELECTs inherit the flag and have join-reorder disabled even if they did not specify STRAIGHT_JOIN.

subject: planner: support straight_join() hint in CTEs and subqueries (#65696)
summary: Adds plan-hint parsing for `straight_join()` (per query block) and wires it into `PlanBuilder.inStraightJoin` so joins built inside CTEs/subqueries are marked `StraightJoin`; adds integration tests for join order in CTE/subquery blocks.
